label: B-task-1
finalMessage:
Tasks now have an optional `priority` of `low`, `medium` or `high`, defaulting to `medium`. `npm test` (7 tests) and `npm run typecheck` pass. I didn't start the app or call the endpoints, so the API behaviour is untested end to end.

- **New migration:** `db/migrations/003_add_task_priority.sql` adds a `priority` column that is not null, defaults to `medium`, and has a `check` limiting it to the three values. `git status` shows it as the only change under `db/migrations`. Existing rows get `medium`.
- **`lib/tasks.ts`:** `Task` has the new field and `createTask` accepts and inserts it. An unknown value, `null` or a non-string throws `RuleViolation`, so the API returns 422 instead of letting the DB `check` fail as a 500.
- **API:** `app/api/tasks/route.ts` needed no change. POST passes the body through, and GET returns `priority` because `toTask` now maps it.
- **Tests added in `lib/tasks.test.ts`:**
  - `defaults priority to medium`
  - `stores and returns each valid priority`
  - `rejects an unknown priority` (covers `"urgent"`, `""`, `null` and `1`)

I added the route-level behaviour (422 on a bad value) only through the `lib/tasks.ts` rule. The agreement notes the repo has no route-test helper, so there is no HTTP-level test.
